claims.name: rollover-eof-and-pending-generation-recovery
claims.statement: Both history formats preserve exact source/suffix/older manifest and archive bytes while normalizing only mutable terminal LF separators. Pending segment IDs remain JSON strings after numeric eligibility; actual reruns recover the exact generation, and contradictory same-HEAD metadata or invalid targets reject without publication. The complete original/repaired proof retains91 immutable Git fixture inputs and36 public commands/41 checks per epoch, original RED12/final GREEN41, a causal JSON type RED/GREEN probe and153 effective evidence controls. The complete58-input book renders17 examples/four chapters with28 RED controls.31 prior entry claim hashes verify before exact historical freeze. The historical-audit compatibility repair reconstructs only the committed Contracts import/loop and Phase0 nested-boundary insertion, preserving24 checkpoints/257 historical source references/149 selected sources and134 archived inputs/84613241 bytes. Three complete guarded commands retain original auditor RED, isolated recovery GREEN and46 boundary groups; 22 recovery/56 evolution/20 audit-evidence controls pass.
claims.scope: Original producer at224d5443 and fixed pressure-bearing public Git sources atb2156813. Each report losslessly retains all91 source inputs, the full actual producer and read-only Git source shim. Fixture views are ordinary repository-local files, not new repositories; the shim permits only show/rev-parse and resolves HEAD to the declared exact public source identity. No Git metadata write occurs. Complete per-command file/symbolic-target guards and unfiltered stdout/stderr/exits distinguish recovery, false duplicate publication and no-write rejection. No-index whitespace RED is exit3 with the exact EOF diagnostic; clean differing files produce exit1 and empty channels. Missing pending-target rejection is observed exit2, other named invalid-input failures exit255. The reviewer reconstructs the full original root including the one omitted LF from its bound Git prefix; archive-only --all remains unchanged. Source inverse permits only EOF normalization, pending string restoration and same-HEAD metadata rejection. Actual production manifests/archives and all schema/capacity scalars are unchanged. The registered DOCUMENT-HISTORY gate executes the retained actual regression. Initial preamble, no-index exit, book summary and missing-target reviewer corrections are separately retained and not accepted final counts. The warned direct invocation lacks separately enveloped complete outer streams and is diagnostic only; final accepted outer channels are complete and empty on stderr. Existing startup .7 owns wrapper establishment/liveness; no recovery/purge or lifecycle guarantee. Host Perl/Git/mdBook executables are necessary read-only toolchain inputs; project data stays on the repository volume and other repositories remain read-only. No language/runtime/schema/helper/callback/dependency change or black-box inspection. The first exact canonical candidate is retained with its complete combined stream and binary staged diff; it exits1 only for reserved checked-label wording and diagnostics chapter pressure and supplies no receipt. The new detail is routed to the existing documentation-workflow chapter without raising limits. Five current report-path probes distinguish valid relative output from traversal, absolute, symbolic-parent and Git-metadata destinations; the old lexical guard witness is retained without outside writes. Those current instrument probes are shared by both epochs; original refers to the old rollover producer, not an old path-validation acceptance. The second candidate passes all10 doctrines and stops in the historical audit; its complete combined stream and exact staged candidate are retained. Only the source-bound committed Contracts import/loop and Phase0 nested-boundary insertion are normalized; all original checkpoints, hashes, logs and dated runtime claims remain unchanged. Current historical recovery does not re-execute those runtime producers. The added proof guards the conservative complete regular committed parent perl/t/specs source population, two actual literal fixture files, selected historical evidence and actual wrappers/instruments, excluding Gitlinks and nonregular metadata without payload reads. This is a supplied boundary, not minimal observed I/O; RGX/PGEN remain black boxes. The narrower selected-input proof, count correction and first post-Contracts Phase0 failure remain retained as preflights. Canonical CI is required by the exact staged receipt before landing; its pass is not inferred from these focused measurements. Complete Legacy acceptance remains .1.4.7-owned; other defects and audits stay with their existing owners.
